answer.main_body: tall wooden watchtower with lookout platform and ladder
answer.evidence: The entire structure below the roof (rows 15-77, over 80% of the sprite) is drawn in a pure 2D front elevation suited for a side-scroller: the platform is a horizontal plank seen directly edge-on with no visible floor surface, crossbeams and ladder rungs are perfectly straight horizontal bars with zero top visibility, and the lookout cabin walls are flat vertical elevations.

The watchtower is drawn in flat front architectural elevation. The lookout platform base (rows 33-35) shows only a 3px front face with zero visible top floor surface, horizontal crossbeams and ladder rungs are completely flat 1-2px lines with no top visible, and the lookout window is a flat rectangular slit.
